name: Milf Barman
detailed_description:
Milf Barman is a cocktail of an erotic visual novel and bartender life simulator, spiced with tantalizing notes. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a resort bar, where you'll not only mix drinks, but destinies as well.

Interact with visitors, guess their secret desires, fulfill their whims – but don't forget about your own passions. In the mysterious town of Oho, everything stays behind closed doors... Or almost everything. After all, the baggage of problems you brought with you to this "vacation" won't disappear. But why think about the past when there's a sea of tempting prospects ahead?

What awaits you:

  • An exciting main story where the fates of many characters intertwine in a whirlwind of intrigue, passion, and coincidences – from fortunate to fateful.

  • Unique client stories: unusual circumstances, unexpected twists and resolutions.The Art of Bartending: mix ingredients, experiment, take risks for the perfect cocktail. But be careful – mistakes can have the most unexpected price.

  • Animated illustrations that bring every scene to life.

  • Special guests: cameos of favorite characters from the EmyLiveShow game series.
